title: REQ · Pixel fonts are installed through npm @fontsource packages and imported locally
summary: Press Start 2P and VT323 bundled from npm
description: Context: no font package is in package.json. Desired: @fontsource/press-start-2p and @fontsource/vt323 as dependencies, imported in main.tsx, referenced by the type tokens. Expected: no font URL anywhere. Why: offline, deterministic fonts.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when read, then both @fontsource packages are in dependencies
Given main.tsx, when read, then it imports each package's 400.css
Given src, styles.css and index.html, when scanned, then no http font URL or fonts.googleapis reference exists
technical_constraints: Fonts bundled through npm packages, not loaded from a URL
dependencies: R1 type tokens name the font families
definition_of_done: npm install resolves and fonts import
